Dear Laurent,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team.  Please be aware that I have conducted an analysis on the charging session interruption and found the temperature plausibility error caused the same. It is normal for the charging session to be interrupted when the temperature differential between the positive and negative terminals exceed15 degrees Celsius. Would you kindly verify whether the end customer charged using an adapter?
